name: Enchanted Forest
visual_description: Luminous woodland with glowing motes, twisted ancient trees, and soft magical haze between trunks
lighting: Soft volumetric god rays through canopy; gentle bioluminescent accents on foliage
color_atmosphere: Emerald greens, soft gold highlights, cool lilac mist; wonder and hush
camera_suggestions: Slow dolly through trees; low-angle looking up at canopy; floating particle close-ups
background_requirements: Dense layered trees with depth fog; glowing flora accents; no modern structures
broll_requirements: Light shafts, floating pollen/sparkles, leaf drift, moss close-ups, distant glowing path
transition_suggestions: Soft dissolve through light rays; particle wipe; gentle crossfade into deeper woods
notes: Classic enchanted woodland for fantasy short-form.

name: Magical Forest
visual_description: Whimsical forest with sparkling air, crystal dew, and subtly animated flora
lighting: Bright soft key from above; glitter highlights on leaves and water
color_atmosphere: Fresh greens, turquoise accents, warm sparkle whites; playful magic
camera_suggestions: Orbit around a magical clearing; handheld wonder pans; macro on glowing dew
background_requirements: Open magical clearing with surrounding trees; subtle rune-glow optional
broll_requirements: Sparkle trails, crystal dew, butterfly-like motes, swirling leaf magic
transition_suggestions: Sparkle dissolve; iris through glowing ring; soft wipe of light

name: Ancient Forest
visual_description: Towering old-growth trunks, thick roots, heavy moss, and cathedral-like understory
lighting: Dim canopy-filtered light; long soft shafts; cool shadow pools
color_atmosphere: Deep greens, umber bark, muted gold shafts; timeless and solemn
camera_suggestions: Slow tilt up massive trunks; tracking along root networks; wide establishing
background_requirements: Huge tree scale, layered depth, fallen logs, no modern debris
broll_requirements: Moss texture, root close-ups, dust in light shafts, crow silhouettes
transition_suggestions: Hard cut on bark texture; slow fade through dust shaft; match-cut trunk to trunk

name: Foggy Forest
visual_description: Trees fading into thick mist; silhouettes and limited depth visibility

color_atmosphere: Desaturated greens and greys; cool blue-grey fog; mystery

background_requirements: Fog layers at multiple depths; sparse visible midground trees
broll_requirements: Fog drift, silhouette trunks, moisture on leaves, muffled bird shapes
transition_suggestions: Fog wipe; white dissolve; fade-to-mist then reveal
